title: Reba's birthday hike
author: HaroldoftheRoc
text: Reba’s birthday hike. She just loves being outdoors no matter what. I’ve never seen a Doxie that enjoys being in the rain
blurb: Shaggy long-haired Reba is out on her birthday hike, snow clinging to her coat against a mountain backdrop. Their human says she's never seen a doxie that loves being outdoors in rough weather this much.
